game_name: Initial D Arcade Stage Ver. 3 (Japan, Rev C) (GDS-0032C)
general_issues: Select initdv3j.zip. Select the exact set in Game Revision; merged archives must contain that revision. Keep naomi2.zip beside the ROM ZIP. Required CHD: gds-0032c.chd. Select CHD Root below the ROM ZIP; disks may be in the set/parent subfolder or directly in that folder.
